notes.title: All new UI on the way!
notes.content:
Hello all, we have been working on a new UI for a bit. This will bring more depth and detail to later upcoming updates including multiplayer and a new game mode. This update will include the new main menu scene as well. Below is a screenshot that displays our new UI for the settings menu. ( It is currently incomplete, but mostly done )

notes.title: New text window and gold indicator
notes.content:
Hello all, our first update is just around the corner with a new text window. This window will display all the text for situations and items you pick up. We will also display your gold count at the bottom of that window. I designed it to be the most least distracting as possible. We plan to make some other GUI changes that will bring more immersion to the player. This update should be available in the next couple weeks, so make sure you check it out.
[img]http://www.dungeonlurk.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/BottomLeftWindow.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gearing Up!
notes.content: With our first public build on Steam, I just wanted to thank anyone that is playing and equally hope you are having fun.  I hope you enjoy the game as much as I do.  As a developer, this is truly the first game I enjoy playing over and over, even though it's a Point 'n' Click.  Of all the games in that genre, my goal was to make this game replayable.  Almost "Nailed it!".  We are getting there, and we hope to bring this genre back, in a HUGE way!.
